provenance: Published manual need in the interrupted real BioY investigation bioy-model-4; this is a dispatch fixture, not a completed scientific result.

published_need.question: Is the target-locus T-like component detectable among the evaluable CDSs in the Bacillus reference window, and is the Bacillus BioY locus sequence-related to the supplied target?
published_need.reason: The two-locus comparison measured proximity to different neighboring proteins. A shared geometry score cannot establish conservation or absence of the same ECF partner. Component detection and a target-to-Bacillus BioY alignment would qualify this contrast without treating unexamined sequence as absence.
published_need.required_information: Provide a complete native protein-homology search of the Rhodobacter RCAP_RS16050 translated CDS against an explicitly identified FASTA containing every evaluable translated CDS in the measured Rhodobacter and Bacillus windows, plus its parsed snapshot, native output, inclusion thresholds and database-source identity. Separately provide a residue-level native alignment between the supplied target and Bacillus BSU_10370/NP_388918.1 with coordinates, identity and both coverages. Report exclusions and any unexamined CDSs; non-detection must remain limited to the actual searched database.
